lines: It has 391,305 GitHub stars in TypeScript.
You want an AI assistant right on your own computer, running in chats you already use.
OpenClaw is a local AI helper for Discord, Slack, Teams, Telegram, or iMessage.
The local gateway handles sessions and tools on your device without sending data outward.
The installer starts onboarding automatically, then you check gateway status and open the dashboard.
The installer script supports macOS Linux Windows WSL2.
It runs on a pnpm workspace and is governed by an independent 501(c)(3) Foundation.
Configure models, connect channels, add tools via ClawHub, or run apps on your local platform nodes.
It is MIT licensed, run by an independent foundation funded by Amazon and OpenAI.
Run openclaw onboard --install-daemon to start onboarding automatically.
Send this to someone who needs an AI on their own device.
Your own lobster way on any device.
